imports.help: Choose a CSV, map its columns, then validate and preview before staging and posting. CSV only; no Excel workbook upload.
imports.headers: Supported stable headers (unmapped columns are ignored):
imports.openingHelp: Use at least one product identity: sku, barcode or product_id. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Quantities count stock units, not packages. Selling price is required; purchase cost is optional. Quote decimal commas, for example "12,50". Each import supports up to 500 rows and 2 MB.
imports.pasteHelp: The first row contains headers. Quoted commas and escaped quotes are supported. Use up to 500 rows and 2 MB; split larger files into smaller imports.
imports.fileReadError: The file could not be read. Try again or paste its contents.
imports.valid: Local validation passed. Server conflict checks must also succeed before staging. Recheck after correcting the file.
imports.invalid: Correct every reported error, then preview again. No rows have been submitted.
imports.staged: Rows staged. Confirm “Post import” when ready to apply them. Staging has not added stock.
imports.partial: Import has row failures: {{success}} imported, {{failed}} failed. Review the results before correcting and importing failed rows in a new file.

posting.permission: You do not have permission to import this row in this branch.
posting.product: The product identity was not found or is ambiguous. Check the SKU, barcode or product ID.
posting.price: The selling price is missing, invalid or differs from the existing lot.
posting.batch: Check the lot, expiry and current batch status. Existing lot details must match.
posting.values: Check the quantity, purchase cost and reason.
posting.duplicate: This row conflicts with an existing identity or earlier submission. Review the saved records before retrying.
posting.failed: This row could not be imported. Check its values and current product/batch records before a new import.

errors.CSV_HEADER_REQUIRED: A non-empty header is required for every column.
errors.CSV_UNEXPECTED_QUOTE: A quote appears outside a correctly quoted field.
errors.CSV_UNCLOSED_QUOTE: A quoted field has no closing quote.
errors.CSV_COLUMN_COUNT: The number of values does not match the header row.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds 2 MB. Split it into smaller files.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: An import supports up to 500 rows. Split this file.
errors.IMPORT_EMPTY: Add at least one data row after the headers.
errors.IMPORT_UNKNOWN_HEADER: An unrecognized column was found. Rename it using the listed column names.
errors.IMPORT_REQUIRED_HEADER: Required columns are missing. Review the listed column names.
errors.IMPORT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED: Enter a SKU, barcode or product ID.
errors.IMPORT_PRODUCT_ID: The product ID must be a valid UUID.
errors.IMPORT_EXPIRY: Enter a real date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
errors.IMPORT_QUANTITY: Quantity must be a positive decimal number.
errors.IMPORT_PURCHASE_COST: Purchase cost must be empty or a non-negative decimal number.
errors.IMPORT_SELLING_PRICE: Selling price must be a positive decimal number.
errors.IMPORT_QUANTITY_PRECISION: Quantity supports up to four decimal places.
errors.IMPORT_MONEY_PRECISION: Costs and prices support up to two decimal places.
errors.IMPORT_DUPLICATE_ROW: Duplicate warning: the file repeats an identity or opening lot. Correct this row before staging.
errors.IMPORT_STOCK_UNIT: Use one of: unit, tablet, capsule, bottle, box, ampoule, tube, sachet, ml, g.
errors.IMPORT_LOCALE: Use en or fr for the customer language.
errors.IMPORT_MAPPING_DUPLICATE: Each destination must be supported and mapped once.
errors.IMPORT_FIELD_LENGTH: The value is too long or contains unsupported control characters. Names: 160; phone: 40; email: 254; address: 500; notes: 2000; other fields: 200 characters.
errors.IMPORT_PHONE: Use 5–20 phone digits with optional +, spaces, parentheses, dots or hyphens.
errors.IMPORT_BARCODE: Use 1–128 visible ASCII characters without spaces; preserve leading zeros.
errors.IMPORT_STATUS: Use active or archived for customer status.
errors.IMPORT_EXISTING: Duplicate/conflict: an existing identity matches. Review the existing record; this row will not overwrite it.
errors.IMPORT_NAME_WARNING: A customer with this name exists. Names do not establish identity; check contact details before creating another.
errors.IMPORT_BATCH_PRICING: Enter purchase cost and selling price through opening-stock batches, not catalog products.
errors.IMPORT_BRANCH: The branch must match the selected active, accessible branch.
errors.IMPORT_PRODUCT_MATCH: Product identifiers must all match one active catalog product.
errors.IMPORT_STOCK_UNIT_MATCH: The stock unit must match the catalog product; no pack conversion is performed.
errors.IMPORT_BATCH_MATCH: An existing lot has different expiry/cost/price or cannot receive stock.
errors.IMPORT_COLUMNS: Use at most 30 source columns. Remove unused columns and try again.
errors.IMPORT_LIMIT: The request exceeds 500 rows or 2 MB including saved original and normalized values. Split it into smaller files.

imports.branchBound: Opening stock branch: {{branch}}. Switching branches clears an unstaged preview; retained attempts stay with their original branch.
imports.createOnly: Create new records only. Existing identities are errors, never overwritten or merged. Posting can accept valid rows and retain row failures; updated/skipped: 0. Product prices and costs belong to opening-stock batches.
imports.mappingHelp: Select each source column to change its destination or ignore it. Required: name for catalog/contacts; lot_number, quantity, expiry_date, selling_price and at least one of sku/barcode/product_id for opening stock. Do not map two columns to the same field.
imports.requiredName: Name is required; other columns are optional. Template rows are fictional examples: replace them before importing. Catalog pricing is entered per batch using opening stock.
imports.postingPlan: Plan: create {{count}} records or opening-stock postings; update 0, skip 0. Nothing changes until “Post import”. All local errors must be corrected first.
imports.recoverHelp: An attempt for {{file}} is retained. Its outcome is uncertain. Recover the same attempt before starting another; never re-upload the full file to retry.
imports.requestFailed: The request could not be confirmed. Keep the retained attempt or refresh saved results before retrying.
imports.historyLimit: Latest 50 organization imports; opening stock is filtered to this branch. Counts are staged before posting and imported/failed after posting.
imports.csvOnly: Choose a .csv file. Export an Excel workbook as CSV first.
imports.recoveryUnavailable: The retained attempt could not be read. It has been preserved. Review saved import history before starting another attempt.
